text: “Write the vision; make it plain on tablets, so he may run who reads it.”
“Which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost?”
“There is a season for everything, and a time for every purpose under heaven.”
“Whoever is faithful with very little is also faithful with much.”
“As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.”

“They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.”
“Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers and sisters, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.”
“Let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds, not giving up meeting together.”
“Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.”
